propositions: Review gates currently read effective criteria and routing through multiple seams, allowing project disables to be ignored and activated project DET criteria to disappear between separate reads.
A single immutable CriteriaSnapshot must be compiled from repository root and operation inputs, serving as the deterministic authority before any selection or model call.

Project code-review LLM criteria must validate applies_to as a non-empty list of globs, with ["**"] spelling repository-wide unconditional selection and reproducing prior ungated behavior for empty changed-files.

The new non-empty-glob rule applies only to code_review project LLM criteria in CriteriaSnapshot; plan-review project criteria and shared _validate_applies_to remain unchanged to preserve compatibility.

Contract tests must prove snapshot correctness by comparing against current behavior when no overlay is present, validating effective disables/retunes and project DET inclusion, and asserting empty-changed-files edge case preservation.
